Deprecated functions in neutr

Source: R/deprecated.R
neutr-deprecated.Rd

These functions were renamed in neutr 0.2.1 to follow snake_case naming. The old names still work but are deprecated and will be removed in a future release. Please use the new names instead:

DeprecatedReplacement
generate.hoppe.urn()generate_hoppe_urn()
generate.hoppe.urn0()generate_hoppe_urn0()
generate.pitman.urn()generate_pitman_urn()
kest.gt()kest_gt()
kest.gt0()kest_gt0()
logl.etienne()logl_etienne()
optim.etienne()optim_etienne()
optim.ewens()optim_ewens()
optim.multideme()optim_multideme()
optim.pitman()optim_pitman()
zeroremove()remove_zero()

The deprecated functions take the same arguments and return the same values as their replacements. They signal a soft deprecation warning with lifecycle::deprecate_soft(): it is shown when a deprecated function is called from the global environment or from tests, but not when it is called from another package.

Usage

generate.hoppe.urn(theta, J)

generate.hoppe.urn0(theta, J, seed = NULL)

generate.pitman.urn(theta, sigma, J)

kest.gt(theta, J, N)

kest.gt0(theta, J, N, nrep = 100)

logl.etienne(input_abundances, theta, m, log_kda = NULL, full = FALSE)

optim.etienne(
  input_abundances,
  init_vals = c(10, 0.5),
  lower = c(1e-06, 1e-08),
  upper = NULL,
  ci = FALSE,
  level = 0.95
)

optim.ewens(input_abundances)

optim.multideme(
  input_abundance_matrix,
  verbose = FALSE,
  I_max = NULL,
  ci = FALSE,
  level = 0.95
)

optim.pitman(
  input_abundances,
  init_vals = c(10, 0.1),
  lower = c(1e-06, 1e-08),
  upper = NULL
)

zeroremove(x)

Arguments

theta, sigma, J, seed, N, nrep, input_abundances, input_abundance_matrix

See the documentation of the replacement function.

m, log_kda, full, init_vals, lower, upper, ci, level, verbose, I_max, x

See the documentation of the replacement function.

Value

See the documentation of the replacement function.
